_note: Exercise catalogue: common home exercises with tags from vocabulary.json. side_mode: per_side (needs a side), bilateral, or none. dose_unit says what a dose counts. 'how' is one plain sentence for the patient view. Approved by Petri on the review page 14.10.2026: every row OK, S2.2 and the S2 dialogue changed on his comments (Atlas dec_053ef87aba2e4ce3).

exercises.how: Stand up from a chair without using your hands, then sit down slowly.
Hold on to a counter, rise onto your toes and lower slowly.
Stand on one foot holding a counter, rise onto your toes and lower slowly.
Stand on one leg next to a counter you can grab, and hold the position.
Bend your knees a little as if to sit, keep your weight on your heels, and stand up.
Squat down as far as is comfortable and stand up again.
Step up onto the bottom stair leading with the named leg, then step down.
Lie on your back, keep the leg straight and lift it to the height of the other knee.
Lie on your back and press the back of the knee down into the bed, hold, then relax.

exercises.en: Seated knee straightening with a band
exercises.how: Sit on a chair with the band around the ankle and straighten the knee slowly.
Lie on your side and lift the upper leg straight up, then lower it slowly.
Lie on your side with knees bent and open the upper knee like a shell, keeping the feet together.
Lie on your back with knees bent and lift your hips off the bed.
Lie on your back with the named knee bent and the other leg straight, and lift your hips off the bed.
Lie on your stomach with both hips straight and stay there.
Lie on your stomach and lift the straight leg a little off the bed.
Walk at a comfortable pace.
Lean against a wall with the named leg behind you, heel down, and hold.
Sit with the named leg straight in front of you and lean forward from the hips until you feel a stretch behind the thigh.
Support yourself on a table with the other hand and let the named arm hang and swing gently in small circles.
Face a wall and slide the named hand up the wall as far as is comfortable.
Keep the elbow against your side and turn the forearm outwards against the band.
Pull the band towards you with both hands, squeezing the shoulder blades together.

exercises.en: Cat and camel on hands and knees
exercises.how: On hands and knees, round your back up and then let it sag gently.
Kneel on the named knee with the other foot in front and shift your weight forward.
Lie on your back and pull the named knee towards your chest.
Lie on your back with knees bent and curl your upper body up.
Sit tall and draw your chin straight back, then relax.
